title: UPDATE: Data Foundation Joins Sui and Walrus for AI Agent Storage

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Large volumes of data will flow to the Sui Network and Walrus Protocol on a regular basis as Data Foundation migrates its operations to the blockchain. The integration aims to establish Walrus as the primary storage infrastructure for the current expansion of autonomous AI agents.

This expansion follows a collaboration between Mysten Labs and Google Cloud to launch the Verifiable Agent Arbiter. That system uses an evidence layer anchored to Sui and Walrus to cryptographically prove corporate AI agents acted within authorized permissions by recording every instruction, action, and payment.
